usage.note: Arithmetic planning range, not measured usage, a bill, or authorization. Previous four-answer/four-review estimate remains 66000-190000. Choose a smaller subset and revise estimate before any execution.

blind_review.masking: Random response IDs and review order, separate citation normalization map, no rewriting. Record reviewer arm guess only after locking scores; style may reveal presentation.
blind_review.scope: AI preparation review is not blind outcome review or external peer review.

reporting: Report exact-object, property, assumptions, scope, conclusion, evidence-status, citation and sufficiency scores separately, with improvements/ties/regressions and both-correct/both-wrong ties. Keep supported-transfer errors and unsupported-claim acceptance separate. Preserve original answers and all failures. Public development tasks cannot establish contamination-free held-out performance.
